strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Ngh... I chased Diondra this far... but it seems she's given me the slip.
...I've strayed far from Rom and the others. ...Enough. Show yourself!
So you knew, Blue Jet. ...It would be no fun otherwise.
Had you turned your back here, I'd have cut you down from behind.
Here, no one is likely to interfere...
Whether we live or die is up to us alone.
The Gyandlar and Earth's turmoil mean nothing! My blade awaits you,
Blue Jet of the Tenku Shinken...!
Globine...! ...I accept your challenge! JEEET!
Heh, that's the opponent I've had my eye on... Here I come!
...Why would a swordsman of your skill serve the Gyandlar!?
Hah! Isn't it obvious! My town was too peaceful.
The townsfolk drove me out, saying a town without strife needs no warrior.
The ones who took me in were the Gyandlar!
A swordsman's job is to fight. I care not who my employer is!
No... You're wrong! Globine!!
Spare me your pretty words! Face my Dark Twin Slayer Sword!
Not bad, Globine... You've earned the right to challenge me...
And you're the swordsman I took you for... No one will interfere!
Let us settle this!
Gladly! ...Or so I'd like to say, Globine! You'd deceive me!?
What!? What are you talking about, Blue Jet!?
Heh heh heh heh.
You lot...!
So it was a trap after all... You're just a Gyandlar pawn too.
Wait! They acted on their own... Blast you, stay out of this!
This is a duel between me and Blue Jet! Interfere and... I'll cut you down!
Whaddaya say!? Here I'm offerin' ya a hand, and ya won't play along!
Ya think Big Sis Diondra's gonna let that slide!?
Grr...! Blue Jet! My spirit for this has soured!
Mine as well. ...Go, Globine. We'll leave this fight for another time.
...Next time, I hope we can fight as true warriors.
True warriors, my foot! Ya won't get off easy next time!
If you've got time to babble nonsense, come at me.
...I'm a bit angry right now...!
Splendid... Tenku Shinken... Blue Jet...
The Dark Twin Slayer Sword... Had I not seen it before, I might have lost.
But... my spirit is not yet broken...!
I won't call it futile. ...Come, Globine...!
Heh heh heh heh.
You lot...!
Hm...!? So it was a trap!
...Globine, I saw you as a true warrior, but...
in the end, you're just a Gyandlar pawn.
Wait! They acted on their own... Blast you, stay out of this!
This is a duel between me and Blue Jet! Interfere and... I'll cut you down!
Whaddaya say!? Big talk for a guy who's all wobbly!
Grr...! Blue Jet! My spirit for this has soured!
Mine as well. ...Go, Globine. The first round of this fight is mine.
...I am in your debt...!
Th-This ain't good! Dang it, all that setup and it still flops!?
We're pullin' out! Strategic retreat!
Devil Saturn 6! Tell Globine this!
I'll face him anytime! I won't run or hide!
Quit showin' off! Next time we'll pound ya flat!
So this is where that woman told us... But no Earth forces here.
That looks like the Gyandlar... and a warrior from planet Cronos.
The Cronos lot seem to be siding with the Earth forces,
so if we torment that one, maybe they'll show up?
Yes... and with the Earth forces is that man too... Heh heh heh...
More newcomers...? They don't look like the Gyandlar, but...
this is starting to get tough.
Heh heh... Even a warrior of planet Cronos,
alone against the Bunker and the Gyandlar, is at a disadvantage, no?
Heh heh... But don't worry, we'll send your friends to hell soon enough!
Jet! Thank goodness, we made it in time! Honestly, Jet!
We rushed after you so fast, now I'm starving...
Drill, we're about to take on the Gyandlar, you know.
Just a little more effort.
...Sorry, everyone.
Don't sweat it... Huh, there's some folks we haven't seen before.
Yeah, they're with the space pirates Bunker... but a different unit.
Be careful.
So your friends have gathered... Fine, I'll send you all to hell together.
Don't think we're the same as the ones you've fought before!
...It makes no difference.
You're still pawns of evil all the same...!
Tenku Chushin Ken... Let's see what it's really worth!
Very well. ...Come!
This asteroid field, is it... Looks like fighting broke out
before we got here... Is that the Bunker and the Gyandlar?
Hah! Did they finally start fighting each other?
That'd make things easy.
No... it looks like a joint operation. But if they're teaming up,
then the enemy they're fighting must be...
Hey, look! Isn't that the powered suit team!?
So it seems... Not good, at this rate they'll be overwhelmed. Captain!
Yes, we owe them many times over...
Not that this repays them, but we can't just look the other way.
All hands, prepare to launch, on the double!
If it's the Bunker, we'll go out first!
Dangaioh... has... arrived...!
...Ufufu...
There it is... Heh heh... Heh heh heh...
Dangaioh has launched.
So fast! They seem extra fired up!
...Aestivalis team, please hurry and prepare to launch, too.
Geez... It's one battle after another... I'd like to relax in the kitchen...
Tenkawa!! What're you being so laid-back for!?
Those heroes of justice are in trouble!
If we don't go help them now, what are we even here for!?
We have no name to give yooou!
Nah, that's not cool at all.
Shut up, you guys! The enemy won't wait, get ready to sortie now!!
Sorry for the wait. Switching roles once in a while is refreshing, no?
Not bad.
Miss, the people from Earth have come to help us!
We're saved! Now we can fight the Gyandlar on even terms!
I see. Being rescued isn't a bad feeling.
I'd hoped not to drag them into our battle if I could...
but for now, let's gladly accept their help.
All right, time to fight back!
Heh heh... Finally you've come. Earth forces... no, Dangaioh!!
Hm? This seems to be a different Bunker unit from before...
...Gil doesn't seem to be here... but I have a bad feeling...
Come on, you Bunker scum!
As long as Dangaioh is here, we won't allow your evil!
My, my... Have you already forgotten our voices,
Roll Kran...?
...!! That voice... could it be...
Roll, do you know her...?
Ngh... N-No way...
What's wrong, Roll? Pull yourself together!!
Ufufu... Roll, I'll send you back to hell...!
I see why Gil has such trouble with you... Oh well.
Roll Kran... We'll meet again.
This time was just to say hello.
Next time, I'll make sure to kill you... Heh heh heh heh...
...Flash, Burst...!
True warriors, my foot! Ya won't get off easy next time!
If you've got time to babble nonsense, come at me.
...I'm a bit angry right now...!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
We drove them off...
Thank you very much, people of Earth.
Hey, no need to thank us.
You guys have helped us out plenty of times.
We were just repaying a debt. It's nothing.
Still, for you guys, who show up out of nowhere, to get surrounded...
that's a rare sight.
We found a Gyandlar commander near here, and while we were chasing him...
it looks like we fell right into their trap.
Honestly, Jet! You went off on your own...
(Globine... We couldn't settle it this time either...)
Who cares? We drove 'em off in the end!
Sure, but... Put another way, all we did was drive 'em off, y'know?
He's right...
Now that the Gyandlar have started sending their commanders,
the fighting will be harder than ever.
Which means we can't afford to sit around either.
I don't suppose I could convince you to stay at this point...
but it would be reassuring to fight alongside you.
When the time comes... Farewell. Let's go, everyone!
Okey-dokey. See ya, Earth folks!
Let's meet again!
Take care~
What a shame...
Nergal would very much like them to come along with us...
You just want to study their machines, right?
Well... I'm rather intrigued by them myself...
I can't even imagine how they're built.
I want a transforming suit like that too...
Transforming...? Captain, what would you transform into?
Isn't it obvious! Into a sexier body! You know, like boom!
You'll need to tighten that waist first, or it'll just look silly, y'know?
Keeping a figure is the hard part. Can you manage, Captain?
That's what the transforming is for!
You've got it wrong from the ground up.
The powered suit team has left sensor range.
They're gone... Anyway, that new Bunker pair...
Who are they, Roll?
They seemed to know you pretty well...
...Roll... who are they...?
...Sorry, everyone... Let me think for a bit...
My, my, sounds like a pretty heavy story...
Roll, we must head to our next destination right away...
Can you sortie?
...I'm fine.
Geez, that's not a very reassuring answer...
Shut it, Shinobu! ...Everyone needs time to sort out their feelings!
Anyway, our priority now is heading to the next destination.
All units, withdraw and get some rest while you can.
(There's no mistake... That voice was...)
Roll...
